title: Informational Mpemba Effect for Fast State Purification in Non-Hermitian System
summary: Quantum systems are inherently fragile to environmental fluctuations or decoherence, limiting their advantages in applications of quantum information and quantum computation. State purification offers a route to recover the purity of system under noisy conditions. Here, we demonstrate a rapid purification of initially mixed states by harnessing collective reservoir engineering in driven non-Hermitian qubit systems, together with multipartite entanglement generation in larger systems.
